'''''Caarimon Splendor''''' was a ship owned by the [[Metatheran Cartel]]. It was captured by the [[Red Fury Brotherhood/Legends|Red Fury Brotherhood]], a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group, and refitted for use by them. It later traveled to the [[Cularin asteroid belt]], where [[Len Markus]] had it gutted for spare parts.
